{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
total_rows = len(data)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']

print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA orders percentage: {len(qa_orders) / total_rows * 100:.1f}%')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Check for missing revenue after cleaning
print(f'Missing revenue after cleaning: {data["revenue_clean"].isnull().sum()}')

# Display the cleaned revenue sample
data[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head()"}
